category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AC-P)
subcategory_text: Individuals and devices are proofed and bound to credentials, and authenticated commensurate with the risk of the transaction (e.g., individuals’ security and privacy risks and other organizational risks).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IA-2(1) (Multi-Factor Authentication), IA-5 (Authenticator Management)
implementation_examples: Proof individuals and devices, bind them to credentials, and authenticate commensurate with the risk (e.g., sensitive data access requires stronger authentication than public information access)
Capture authentication events and integrate with anomaly detection
Maintain recovery procedures for credential loss
assessment_objectives: Determine whether individuals and devices are proofed and bound to credentials
Determine whether authentication strength is risk-proportionate
Determine whether authentication events are logged and integrated with monitoring
Determine whether credential recovery procedures are secure
